no-restricted-syntax.message: Use theme tokens (bg-background, text-foreground, bg-card, text-muted-foreground, bg-primary, bg-destructive, etc.) instead of literal Tailwind colors. They adapt automatically to dark mode and brand changes. If you genuinely need a fixed color, add // eslint-disable-next-line no-restricted-syntax with a comment explaining why.
